alt: 社區草地上，拿望遠鏡的人圍著小鳥觀察，愛好種植的人聚著比較盆栽，另一群人坐在樹旁一起寫生。
scene_prompt: At a sunny community hobby fair, show three distinct naturally formed small groups, no family gathering: birdwatchers with binoculars cluster excitedly around a bird on a low branch on the left; in the middle plant lovers compare small potted seedlings; on the right sketchers sit together drawing the same tree. Within each group people turn toward their shared interest and similar objects, with generous clear space between the three groups. Different ages and appearances, modern casual clothes. A simple readable wide composition, no signs, no speech or thought bubbles, no matching uniforms.
